## Context checklist

- [ ] This PR touches documented conventions — `AGENTS.md` / model-specific guidance updated if needed.
- [ ] This PR introduces a significant architecture/product/design decision — new decision record added under `docs/decisions/`.
- [ ] This PR changes a previous decision — superseding decision record added.
- [ ] Relevant existing decision records were considered.
- [ ] This PR implements or changes a non-trivial feature — PRD/spec updated or added.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behavior and bug fixes.
- [ ] User-visible changes noted in `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased).
- [ ] `HANDOFF.md` updated if this changes the next session’s priorities or blockers.
